narrative.overview: The whole product is a handheld from the year 2000 lying on a desk: the Ginhouse Pocket GH-25, in translucent Jelly Teal plastic, with Bengaluru Bingo as the cartridge that is always in it. The game is played on its colour LCD, by tapping the screen or with the D-pad, A, B, START and SELECT. Everything on the LCD is pixel art, in one fixed palette.
keyCharacteristics: A translucent candy-plastic console on a dark checkered desk, with hard bevels and hard shadows only.
A pale green-cream LCD with ink text, a blinking bracket cursor and yellow stamped tiles.
Illustration is pixel art on fixed grids (16x16 tiles, 64x44 avatars) from a 16-colour keyed palette, with dot eyes.
Everything moves in steps: wipes, blinks and key presses, never springs or fades.

rules.name: The One Palette Rule
rules.body: There are no seasons. Components use the fixed tokens (desk, shell, bezel, lcd, btn, cat) and never a raw hex or a date.

rules.name: The AA Rule
rules.body: LCD text is ink or dim on paper, white or stamped; paper on ink; or white on stamp magenta. Never white on button pink. Scanlines stay at 6% so every pair holds 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Sentence Rule
rules.body: Press Start 2P and Silkscreen are for a few uppercase words. Every sentence is set in Pixelify Sans.

rules.name: The Unit Rule
rules.body: Everything on the console is sized in u, one 344th of the device width, so the console scales as one object and tiles never drop under 53px.

rules.name: The Hard Pixel Rule
rules.body: Shadows have zero blur, corners are square or stepped, art is rects on a grid with crispEdges, and motion uses steps().

rules.name: The Two Paths Rule
rules.body: Everything the hardware keys do is also reachable by tapping the LCD or a real link or button, and by keyboard.

dos: Do size everything on the console in u and keep every key's hit area at 44px or more.
Do draw sprites as text grids with the single-character palette keys and render them as SVG rects with crispEdges.
Do give every sprite a closed 1px ink outline, one highlight, one shadow, and dot eyes.
Do use the doubled ink-plus-yellow focus ring on every focusable element.
Do keep sound and vibration behind the single persisted mute switch, and drop animation under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use any third-party console name, logo, boot animation or look-alike proportions.
Don't bring back seasonal colours, a season switch or month logic.
Don't use anti-aliased art, soft shadows, blur, glows, springs, rotation or the 3D flip.
Don't set sentences in Press Start 2P or Silkscreen, or put white text on button pink.
Don't ship audio files, image files, icon fonts or emoji icons.
